summary.text: Gerald Neal is a Democratic member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 33, serving since 1989. The legislature's profile lists Neal as Senate Minority Floor Leader.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Gerald A. Neal was born on September 22, 1945, and is an attorney.
The profile lists a B.A. from Kentucky State University and a J.D. from the University of Louisville, along with study at the University of Michigan.
It also lists membership in the Kentucky and National bar associations and the Urban League.
